tools.name: r2r_observe
tools.description: Submit an untrusted probabilistic observation. The server binds trusted admission metadata, runs Evidence Admission, and applies only admitted evidence to the subject/scope R2R governance domain.

tools.name: r2r_decide
tools.description: Evaluate a proposed action against persistent R2R governance state without mutating relation state. The call records an auditable decision, so it is not environment-read-only under MCP ToolAnnotations semantics.

tools.name: r2r_validate_execution
tools.description: Validate that an ALLOW decision is still executable by binding the attempted action to the exact durable R2R state_version from which the decision was derived. Stale, denied, unknown, or action-mismatched decisions fail closed.

tools.name: r2r_explain
tools.description: Explain a previously issued R2R decision using its recorded domain, state version, and causal provenance chain.

tools.name: r2r_record_outcome
tools.description: Record the observed result of a governed action. Outcome data is untrusted audit input in v0.1 and cannot directly mutate relation state.

tools.name: r2r_replay
tools.description: Deterministically replay stored observation events for a subject/scope domain using their recorded trusted Admission context and report the first divergence.

notes: This file is a repository discovery catalog, not an alternative MCP protocol implementation.
The normative runtime tools are implemented by the rmcp router in src/mcp/server.rs plus the protocol decorator in src/mcp/annotated.rs.
r2r_validate_execution is exposed only in durable mode when R2R_STORE_PATH is configured.
Real stdio integration tests assert the tool surface and execution-binding behavior.
Annotations follow MCP ToolAnnotations environment semantics. r2r_decide does not mutate Relation Graph state but does persist an audit decision, so readOnlyHint is false.
